notes.title: We are Live on BrightLocker!
notes.content:
Bleak is live on [url=https://www.brightlocker.com/games/bleak]BrightLocker[/url]!  Brightlocker is a relatively new way for fans like you to back the game early, earn special rewards, and share your thoughts and ideas to our Brightlocker page and get direct feedback from the team making the game.
    
    BrightLocker offers multiple ways to support the project; you can make a one time donation toward the development of Bleak or make a monthly sustaining contribution toward development. All funding goes directly into the development of the game, with each contribution allowing us to complete the game sooner.

    Contributions come with rewards (and our undying gratitude) ranging from access to a special Discord channel where backers can communicate directly to the development team, early access pre-order discounts, special in-game skins, your name in the credits, and more; all while getting a behind the scenes look into the ongoing development of the game with dev blogs, screenshots, and more.

    We encourage everyone to check out the Bleak page on BrightLocker! Consider backing early and choosing a reward. You can ask us questions about the game's development or simply leave a comment telling us what you like or what type of new features you would like to see added to Bleak.

    Together with your help we believe we can make great things happen in gamedev.

[url=https://www.brightlocker.com/games/bleak]BrightLocker Link[/url]
